records.note: RDA's own 7th-edition table and the MFDS raw-material list independently define the food 비름 as Amaranthus mangostanus. The current RDA record (2015 analysis) keeps the same food concept (대표식품코드 06093) but does not print a species, so this is a food-name mapping, not a voucher-level identification of the 2015 sample. The global Amaranthus spp. master remains broad.
